sources.title: The AI founders who walked away from Bezos-backed Prometheus to model the universe
sources.quote_checked: The language-centric view of intelligence is humans at the centre. Putting physics at the centre is a nature-centric view.

sources.title: Interview with AAAI Fellow Anima Anandkumar: neural operators for science and engineering problems
sources.quote_checked: Neural Operators are a general AI technique for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDE) | Neural Operators are able to learn complex physical phenomena that occur at multiple resolutions | FourCastNet was the first fully AI-based weather model and was built using Neural Operators. | It is tens of thousands of times faster than traditional weather models | Language models are unable to do so since they have no physical grounding. | I believe that the future of science is AI+Science

sources.title: Why Transformers Hit a Wall the Moment Physics Shows Up — Anima Anandkumar, Caltech
sources.quote_checked: So forget ever having a transformer for anything of this scale, all of the world's compute will not be enough. | All of the things that work with deep learning, let's take them, but make them a bit more principled.
